suite: h="$WORKDIR/sandbox-$DEFECT_ID"; mkdir -p "$h/home" "$h/tmp" && cd "$h" && exec env -i PATH="$PATH" HOME="$h/home" TMPDIR="$h/tmp" LC_ALL=C GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES="$h" node "$MUTANT" --selftest

K_KIND.selftest_case: TIER_ENUM: fixture reports kind with expected exit
K_KIND.reason: The TIER_ENUM fixture asserts both the error exit and the TIER_ENUM kind, so changing its emission to KIND_ENUM fails that case.

S_KIND.selftest_case: every declared finding kind fires in a fixture (one-sided; no case asserts that observed kinds are all declared)
S_KIND.reason: Removing RECHECK_OVERDUE from FINDING_KINDS does not alter emission, and the coverage check only tests declared kinds against observed kinds.

K_EXIT.selftest_case: invalid/missing option value uses usage exit 64
K_EXIT.reason: The usage fixture requires status 64, while the mutant returns 65 for parse errors.

S_VERDICT.selftest_case: DRIFT fixtures assert exit and finding kind; none asserts the final DRIFT verdict line
S_VERDICT.reason: The mutant changes only the final DRIFT text, while selftest assertions read finding kinds and exits; CLEAN and fail-closed lines remain unchanged.

K_STRICT.reason: The strict warning fixture expects USED_BY_ASYMMETRY with exit 1, but the mutant leaves warn findings unpromoted.

K_CLOSED.reason: The missing-SOURCES fixture pins the SOURCES_MISSING kind in the final verdict, which the mutant changes to READ_FAILED.

K_ROWS.selftest_case: frozen awk census parity: rows, malformed, duplicate ids
K_ROWS.reason: Doubling each valid-row increment makes the JS row count disagree with the awk census, and the clean fixture also pins rows=1.

S_DUP_LINE.selftest_case: ID_DUPLICATE: fixture reports kind with expected exit (line number is not asserted)
S_DUP_LINE.reason: The mutant changes only the reported duplicate line number; fixture and parity checks assert duplicate kind/count, not its location.

S_ENTRY_COUNT.selftest_case: --json prints one parseable contract object (checks rows only; positive entriesWithSource is not pinned)
S_ENTRY_COUNT.reason: The doubled entriesWithSource value is reported in JSON/text but no selftest asserts its positive value.

S_FILE_READ.selftest_case: READ_FAILED: fail-closed exit 2 (fixture exercises directory-read failure, not per-file read failure)
S_FILE_READ.reason: The mutant changes only the per-entry read catch, which no fixture reaches; the existing READ_FAILED fixture fails earlier at readdirSync.
